dataList.title:
District 19
19区
dataList.content:
*pant* *pant* It's just up ahead, young man. Soon, we shall find ourselves past the border of the T Corp. Backstreets...
哈啊、哈啊……再加把劲。很快……就要到T公司的后巷了……

dataList.title:
District 19
19区
dataList.content:
What... *pant* What happened to everyone else?
其他、呼……其他人去哪里了？

dataList.title:
District 19
19区
dataList.content:
All snared by the Ch'unokkuns... those vile wretches...
呼……推奴人，那些狠毒的家伙们，将大家全都抓走了……

dataList.title:
District 19
19区
dataList.content:
S-sir, behind you! Look behind you!
大、大叔，背后！在你背后！

Gotcha.
抓到了。
dataList.title:
Ch'unokkun
推奴人

dataList.content:
It is well into the late hours of the night, only a few minutes after the Night of the Backstreets has passed.
后巷深宵刚刚结束，时刻已晚。

The child, hot on the heels of the two residents who had chosen to use that precarious hour as cover to flee S Corp., threw a heavy lasso at one of them.
孩子趁着这个空档，追着逃跑的S公司居民，投出了结实的绳子。
The lasso was made from ropes called Ohra, or Scarlet Bonds. 捕绳，或者被称作吾罗的红色绳索。

The fugitive fell to the ground helplessly, and was soon dragged before the child.
被这根绳索束缚住的居民，会在无法进行任何抵抗的状态下，无计可施地被拖到孩子面前。

dataList.title:
District 19
19区
dataList.content:
No!
大叔！

dataList.title:
District 19
19区
dataList.content: Forget about me and flee! Go! 逃啊！快点！

The fugitive shouted in a desperate attempt to at least get the boy out of there, but...
居民想着至少要帮助还没被抓住的孩童逃出去，便急切地大喊道……
... the child was a Ch'unokkun, and Ch'unokkuns never hunt alone. 身为推奴人的孩子并不是独自追捕奴婢的。

Unlike the Royal Censors, who act under royal decree, Ch'unokkuns are Fixers, each serving their own interests.
与接受御命而行动的御史们不同，推奴人们是为了各自的利益聚集起来的收尾人。

And when the hunt begins, they form packs with those among their ranks who stand to gain from the same pursuit.
当然，兴趣相投的人们会成群结队地追逐奴婢。

Can I trust you to handle the kid?
那边就拜托你啦？
dataList.title:
Ch'unokkun
推奴人

Ch'unokkun
推奴人
dataList.content:
Of course.
好吧。

dataList.title:
District 19
19区
dataList.content:
... I thought we had lost you in the maze of alleys. I commend your tenacity, for what it's worth.
……我本来以为已经在巷子里甩掉你们了，真是些纠缠不休的人啊。

Hehe, I hate to break it to you, but these parts are a common escape route for you fugitives~
哈哈。因为逃往这里的人真的很多嘛~
dataList.title:
Ch'unokkun
推奴人

dataList.content:
So thanks to you, I can navigate this entire network of alleys with my eyes closed!
多亏如此，就算闭上眼睛，这条巷子的每一个角落我也都了如指掌哦？
dataList.title:
Ch'unokkun
推奴人

District 19
19区
dataList.content:
... And you're proud of that?
……你是把这当做炫耀吗？

Proud? No, it's got nothing to do with pride—I've just been here enough times that I know it like the back of my hand.
并非炫耀。只是习惯了的意思。常走的路，不是很容易就记住了吗？
dataList.title:
Ch'unokkun
推奴人

dataList.content:
Those seeking a way out of S Corp. didn't have that many options, which made their routes rather predictable.
从S公司逃走的人们所去往的地方实在是太过明显了。

They would often make for the borders between Districts, where their hunters know they are likely to turn up...
就是更为靠近其他区域的地方。

In the cover of dark alleyways, the narrow spaces between collapsed walls, and within abandoned homes where those with nowhere else to hide go find what little refuge they are afforded...
尤其是昏暗的巷子与崩塌的围墙之间，以及人烟稀少的废屋。

There was no mistaking it: the fugitives fleeing their homeland already knew that these were the places the Ch'unokkun were keen to look.
逃跑的居民们大概也明白，推奴人们会将这些地方的每一个角落翻个遍。

But it wasn't like they had any alternatives.
可即便如此，他们也没有别的办法了。

There weren't any other places to go, anyway.
因为除此以外，他们连能逃跑的地方都没有。

dataList.title:
District 19
19区
dataList.content:
... I've already given up any hope of seeing S Corp. change for the better.
……我连S公司会改变这件事都不再指望了。

dataList.title:
District 19
19区
dataList.content:
I've given up. I no longer care about its current state of affairs—all we want is to put this place behind us and never look back, yet you still pursue us with such doggedness... Why...?
你们按老样子来就是了。我们不过是实在看不下去那副模样才选择离开。为何要对我们这般穷追不舍呢……

Because it pays to bring you in. And who knows, maybe I'll land a big fish and climb my way up the ladder.
因为抓住各位是能换到钱的。以及虽然可能性不高，但运气好的话能借此出人头地呢。
dataList.title:
Ch'unokkun
推奴人

dataList.content:
There's something I've been wondering for a while, actually.
其实我一直很好奇一件事情。
dataList.title:
Ch'unokkun
推奴人

dataList.content:
Why does your kind flee? Do you actually expect something to change? There's nothing for you in the other Districts.
你们为什么要逃呢？就算逃走了，也不会有任何改变吧。
dataList.title:
Ch'unokkun
推奴人

dataList.content:
You think your life'll improve once you make it to a different Wing? The Wings are all the same. There's nothing you penniless, powerless people can do to better your lives.
该不会是觉得去了别的翼就能过得更好吧？说到底，没有金钱和权力的话，在哪里都没区别。
dataList.title:
Ch'unokkun
推奴人

dataList.content:
Thrash and struggle from within, flee to a different Wing without, but nothing will change.
明明不管在里面苦苦挣扎，还是逃到外头去，都不会有任何改变。

Why do they flee, knowing the risk to their lives? What could possibly be motivating them?
究竟是什么样的动机，让他们不惜赌上性命也要逃走呢。

The child failed to understand the drive behind their desperation to flee.
孩子无法理解那不顾一切的态度。

And he never will.
今后大概也不会理解吧。

dataList.title:
District 19
19区
dataList.content: ... You think we're fleeing in search of warmth and safety? In search of a home, nay, in search of anything? ……温暖安稳的地方。安全的地方。你觉得我们是为了追求那些东西才逃的吗。

dataList.title:
District 19
19区
dataList.content:
Wrong. We've grown... too weary to hope, too spent to expect even the faintest turn toward better days.
不是的。我们……早已疲惫不堪，疲惫到连怀抱着那样的希望与期待活着都做不到了。

dataList.title:
District 19
19区
dataList.content:
We only seek to be free of this hell.
我们不过是想逃离这个地狱罢了。

dataList.title:
District 19
19区
dataList.content:
Free of this awful hell that will reave us of our families, our neighbors, and eventually... our lives.
逃离这个夺去了我们的家人、邻里，也终将连我们自己的人生也一并夺走的……这个可怕的地狱。

Be careful what you wish for, because you might find an even worse hell at the end of your journey.
在这份愿望的尽头，等待着你们的或许是一个更加可怕的地狱呢？
dataList.title:
Ch'unokkun
推奴人

District 19
19区
dataList.content:
That may be so. A life more horrid than this may indeed await us.
正如你所说，前方或许正有更加可怕的生活在等待着我们。

dataList.title:
District 19
19区
dataList.content:
But to us, who wish for nothing save liberty, the uncertainty of tomorrow is a peril we would take with willing hearts.
即便如此，我们还是想离开。哪怕多一个人也好，我希望他们能离开这里。

Somewhat unhappy with the resident's cryptic reply, the child stopped chatting with the captured Nobi...
孩子似乎并不喜欢居民那令人难以理解的回答，便不再开口……

... and the captive, too, fell quiet, eyes turned toward the direction where the Nobi boy had fled.
居民也没有再多说什么，只是静静地望着另一名奴婢逃走的道路。

After an indeterminable amount of time spent in silence...
在那阵沉默里，不知又流逝了多少时间。

... the other Ch'unokkun returned, but instead of welcoming his return, the child responded with a click of his tongue...
看到自己的同事回来，孩子轻轻地咂了一下舌。

... when he noticed that his pair came back empty-handed, evidently having lost the boy.
因为他的推奴人同事……身边没带着任何人，是独自一人回来的。

... Where's the boy?
……怎么空着手回来了？
dataList.title:
Ch'unokkun
推奴人

Ch'unokkun
推奴人
dataList.content:
Got stopped by some new upstart Syndicate. Said I was to cough up a toll if I wanted to get past them.
被一个没见过的帮派拦住了，让我交过路费。

That can't be helped, I guess. We're running a business, after all—no need to incur unnecessary expenses.
那就算了。说到底这是一门生意，没理由为了追他们让自己吃亏。
dataList.title:
Ch'unokkun
推奴人

dataList.content:
As they were preparing to return the Nobis, the child noticed something that soured his mood. It was the look on the captured Nobi's face. A smile.
在催促奴婢们准备撤离的时候，孩子看见那个居民脸上带着笑意，皱起了眉头。

The child frowned, puzzled by the fugitive's strange cheer. Surely he knew that his treatment would only grow harsher once he was dragged back. What could he possibly be smirking about?
明明等到回去后，他必然会遭受比逃跑前更残酷的对待，究竟为什么笑得那么开心呢。

Curious, the child tugged on the Scarlet Bond tied to the fugitive, and asked:
猜到其中缘由的孩子，收紧手中的捕绳把他拽到身边，开口问道。

... That boy who got away, he's just a stranger to you, isn't he? He's not even your kin.
……不就逃掉一个人吗？而且还是个和你毫不相干的外人。
dataList.title:
Ch'unokkun
推奴人

dataList.content:
You do know they're going to punish you once you're taken back, right? For all that effort, all you managed was to help just one other person escape. So tell me—whatever are you smiling for?
明知回去之后过得会比之前更惨，你居然还笑得出来吗？
dataList.title:
Ch'unokkun
推奴人

dataList.content:
The child's query was met with another quiet smile.
听了孩子的话，居民什么也没有回答，只是笑着。

What that smile carried...
那笑容意味着什么……
... this child would never understand. 恐怕这里的孩子一生都无法参透吧。
